chapter.verse: Ciaptehna gip a sagihna Tuuno in a hon ciangin vantung ah nai lang sung gamdaihna om hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mai-a a ding vanmi sagih ka mu a, amau' tungah pengkul sagih kipia hi.

Tua laitak, kham meibungno a tawi vanmi a dang khat hong pai-in biakpiaktau gei-ah ding a, ama' tungah paknamtui tampi ki-ap hi. Tua pen kumpi-tokhom mai-a kham biakpiaktau tungah mi siangthote' thungetna tawh a luuikhop ding ahi hi.
Tua ciangin mi siangthote' thungetna tawh kiluuikhawm paknamtui meikhu pen vanmi' khut pan Pasian' mai-ah khuto hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in kham meibungno la a, biakpiaktau pana mei tawh a dimsak khit ciangin leitung ah lawnsuk hi. Kekkia, vanging, khuaphia leh zinling cihte om hi.
Tu-in pengkul sagih a nei vanmi sagihte pengkul tum dingin kiging uh hi.

Vanmi khatna in a pengkul tum a, sisan kihel gial leh mei in zui-in tuate leitung ah kilawnsuk hi. Leitung seh thum-ah-khat kangtumin singkung seh thum-ah-khat kangtum a, lopa hing kici khempeuh zong kangtum hi.
Vanmi nihna in a pengkul tum a, mual lianpi tawh a kibang khat, mei in kangin tuipi tungah kilawnsuk a, tuipi seh thum-ah-khat sisan suak hi.
Tuipi sunga nuntakna neite seh thum-ah-khat si uh a, tembaw seh thum-ah-khat kisia hi.
Vanmi thumna in a pengkul tum a, vantung pan meitawn bangin a kuang zaizai aksi lianpi khat kiasuk a, gun seh thum-ah-khatte' tung leh tuinakte' tungah tusuk hi.
Tua aksi a min Gamsaai ahi hi. Tui seh thum-ah-khat gamsaai tui suak a, a kha dingin kibawl ahih manin tua tui hangin mi tampi si hi.

Vanmi lina in a pengkul tum a, ni seh thum-ah-khat, kha seh thum-ah-khat leh aksi seh thum-ah-khat kisusia hi. Tua ciangin amaute a taanna uh seh thum-ah-khat bei-in sun hun seh thum-ah-khat a taang om lo a, zan hun seh thum-ah-khat zong tua bang mah ahi hi.

Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh musane khat vankim lai-ah awging lianpi tawh kiko a, “Dahhuai, dahhuai, dahhuai! Vanmi thumte' hong tum ding pengkul dangte hong ginkhiat ciangin leitunga om mite' ading a dahhuaizia!” ci hi.
